name: BuilderGlut
author: AppGlut

sections.description:
BuilderGlut provides powerful custom Gutenberg blocks that extend WordPress’s block editor with advanced layout capabilities. Create flexible container and column layouts with ease using our intuitive drag-and-drop interface.

Key Features:

  • Container Block: Wrap other blocks in customizable containers with spacing, colors, and background options
  • Column Block: Create responsive column layouts within containers
  • Template Library: Access pre-built templates and layouts (coming soon)
  • Responsive Design: All blocks are mobile-friendly and responsive
  • Custom Styling: Full control over colors, spacing, padding, and margins
  • Block Category: Organized under dedicated “BuilderGlut” category in the block inserter

Perfect for:

  • Web designers and developers
  • Content creators who need flexible layouts
  • Anyone wanting more control over WordPress page layouts
  • Users who want to create professional-looking pages without coding

The plugin integrates seamlessly with the WordPress block editor (Gutenberg) and follows WordPress coding standards and best practices.

Support

For support, please visit our website at https://www.appglut.com or contact us through the WordPress.org support forums.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/builderglut directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Start using BuilderGlut blocks in your WordPress editor under the “BuilderGlut” category
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with all themes?

Yes, BuilderGlut is designed to work with any WordPress theme that supports Gutenberg blocks.

Is BuilderGlut responsive?

Absolutely! All BuilderGlut blocks are designed with mobile-first responsive principles.

Can I customize the styling of the blocks?

Yes, BuilderGlut blocks support WordPress’s built-in color and spacing controls, allowing you to customize backgrounds, text colors, padding, and margins.

Do I need coding knowledge to use BuilderGlut?

Not at all! BuilderGlut is designed for users of all skill levels and provides an intuitive drag-and-drop interface.
